cards.card_text: The winepress is trodden outside the city, and the blood that flows from it rises as high as the bridles of the horses, for a distance of 1,600 stadia.
cards.verse_text: And the winepress was trodden outside the city, and the blood that flowed from it rose as high as the bridles of the horses for a distance of 1,600 stadia.
cards.snippet: …high as the bridles of the horses for a distance of 1,600 stadia.

cards.card_text: Then the angel measures the city with a golden rod: 12,000 stadia long, wide AND high, all equal.
cards.verse_text: And he measured the city with the rod, and all its dimensions were equal—12,000 stadia in length and width and height.
cards.snippet: …measured the city with the rod, and all its dimensions were equal—12,000 stadia in length and width and height.
